name: Pochitama
source:
Main character is born in a noble family and is presented with a dog ear and cat ear girl as pets for his birthday. Father has high expectations of the boy, but first protagonist needs to prove that he can handle training slaves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角出生于贵族家庭，生日时被赠送狗耳少女和猫耳少女作为宠物。父亲对这个男孩抱有很高的期望，但首先主角需要证明他可以训练奴隶。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
